x: At about half distance apart from Barrett of Cambridge Harriers, the front part of the race looked almost like a Belgrave Club race with Gerry Gregory, Harry Churcher, Dave McMullen and Syd James all on each other's heels.
Gerry Gregory took an early lead on the uphill climb over the first mile and gradually increased it on the outward journey being followed by Barrett and Harry Churcher.
